By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products. THE ROLE We’re looking for a high-performing strategic finance professional to join our growing Finance team. This role is ideal for someone with 3 - 4 years of experience across investment banking, venture capital, private equity and/or strategic finance who wants broad exposure to company-building inside a fast-scaling AI infrastructure company. familiarity with SQL or BI tools is a plus NICE TO HAVE - Experience in AI/ML, cloud infrastructure, or SaaS - Familiarity with usage-based business models BENEFITS - Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity. - 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents - Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!) - Paid parental leave - Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot - Company-facilitated 401(k) - Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities. jobgether-jobgether:lever:10d6a3f8-8f67-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Animator based in India. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced animator to contribute to high-end visual effects for feature films and episodic television projects. You’ll bring characters, creatures, vehicles, props, cameras, and other elements to life while delivering polished animation across assigned shots. The role combines strong artistic judgment with technical problem-solving and an understanding of production pipelines. You’ll participate in dailies, collaborate closely with artists and supervisors, and both give and receive constructive feedback. Your work will contribute directly to ambitious VFX productions while helping maintain a high standard of creative and technical quality. The environment is collaborative, supportive, and focused on continuous learning and development. Animate primary and secondary characters and elements for high-end episodic television and feature film VFX projects. Animate a broad range of assets, including characters, creatures, vehicles, props, and cameras. Complete assigned shots efficiently while consistently delivering work that meets high artistic and technical quality standards. Apply a thorough understanding of core animation principles, shot composition, timing, movement, and performance. Participate actively in dailies sessions, presenting work clearly and incorporating feedback from supervisors and fellow artists. Provide constructive feedback to other artists and contribute positively to a collaborative creative environment. Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve animation-related technical challenges throughout production. Work effectively within the CG pipeline and collaborate with other departments to ensure smooth shot delivery. Maintain efficient production workflows while meeting project schedules and deadlines. Continuously develop animation techniques and contribute to improving the quality and efficiency of production processes. Requirements: Significant professional experience in animation for high-end film and/or episodic television VFX. Strong knowledge of Autodesk Maya and Houdini. Thorough understanding of fundamental animation principles and their application to cinematic shot work. Demonstrated experience animating a variety of assets, including characters, creatures, vehicles, props, and cameras. Strong understanding of shot composition, performance, timing, and visual storytelling. Good knowledge of CG production pipelines and the ability to work effectively within a multi-disciplinary VFX environment. Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, particularly when addressing animation-related production challenges. Ability to respond constructively to feedback and communicate effectively during dailies and collaborative reviews. Excellent attention to detail and a consistent commitment to high-quality work. Ability to work efficiently under production deadlines while maintaining artistic standards. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a collaborative and respectful approach to working with artists and production teams. A proactive attitude toward learning, professional development, and adopting improved techniques and workflows. Benefits: Opportunity to work on high-end feature film and episodic television VFX productions. Collaborative and respectful creative environment where individual contributions are valued. Access to online training platforms and internal learning and development resources. Opportunities to continually develop and refine animation and VFX skills. Opportunity to work alongside experienced and talented VFX professionals. Supportive culture focused on teamwork, personal connections, and continuous improvement. jobgether-jobgether:lever:20e7fcdd-32c6-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Support software architecture decisions, process modeling, governance, quality practices, and continuous improvement initiatives. Strong knowledge of process modeling and documentation, including BPMN, UML, use cases, and technical/functional specifications. Understanding of software architecture, object-oriented programming principles, and design patterns. Experience with REST APIs, web services, system integrations, and microservices architectures. Experience integrating modern applications with enterprise systems such as ERP, MES, CRM, and legacy platforms. Advanced SQL knowledge and experience with data modeling and relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, scalability, security, and cloud-native application practices. Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and software delivery practices. Knowledge of functional, integration, and automated testing, as well as software quality and governance practices. jobgether-jobgether:lever:ef1fab15-fe52-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Integrated Marketing Manager based in France. As Senior Integrated Marketing Manager, you will bring multiple marketing functions together into one coordinated, high-performing execution engine. You will own the master marketing calendar, campaign briefs, publishing standards, launch coordination, and post-launch performance reviews. Working across organic, lifecycle, creators, PR, community, and eventually paid channels, you will turn existing go-to-market plans into measurable outcomes. You will lead three specialists while also remaining highly hands-on, personally building and shipping marketing initiatives rather than delegating execution entirely. A major focus will be establishing scalable processes, bringing external marketing activities in-house, and maintaining a consistently high quality bar. You will work closely with Product, Design, Business Development, and Partnerships to coordinate launches and activate commercial opportunities. This is an ownership-heavy role for a pragmatic marketing leader who thrives in a fast-moving environment and is motivated by measurable growth. Own and maintain a consolidated marketing calendar covering campaigns, channels, launches, owners, draft deadlines, go-live dates, and post-launch performance reviews. Establish clear accountability for marketing deliverables, ensuring committed dates are treated as firm commitments and results are reviewed within defined timeframes. Lead the creator and influencer program, including sourcing, briefing, reviewing, negotiating rates, managing tracked links and usage rights, and maintaining approval and review processes. Bring the external agency’s creator and influencer activities in-house, taking ownership of relationships and ensuring consistent execution standards. Own the marketing publish gate by implementing a streamlined pre-publish quality assurance process covering messaging, assets, presentation, and visible customer-facing details. Oversee day-to-day lifecycle, organic, and PR marketing activities, including developing an email program for a large existing customer base, organic social, PR initiatives, competitions, and marketing pages. Gradually incorporate paid marketing as budget and attribution capabilities develop, with an initial focus on high-leverage organic, lifecycle, and creator channels. Coordinate go-to-market activities with Product and Design, including launch briefs, campaign communications, and cross-functional execution. Partner with Business Development and Partnerships on co-marketing initiatives and activate marketing opportunities generated through commercial relationships. Lead and develop three marketing specialists across performance and organic marketing, content and brand, and community. Establish clear 30-, 60-, and 90-day objectives, written KPIs, and regular one-on-one meetings to support team performance and accountability. Build the foundations for measurable funnel ownership, ultimately taking responsibility for new paying customers per week across key markets. Maintain a hands-on approach by personally creating, executing, and shipping marketing work while providing direction and quality control across the wider team. Identify opportunities to improve marketing processes, execution speed, quality, attribution, and cross-functional coordination. Requirements 4+ years of hands-on experience delivering multi-channel marketing programs, with experience managing at least one direct report or holding external vendors accountable for delivery. Proven experience personally owning a multi-channel marketing calendar spanning at least three areas such as email/CRM, organic social, community, influencer/creator marketing, PR, or paid marketing.
